headToHead.voiceVerdict: Tie. With the names covered, Tilly passes over 132 lines. She has a real syntactic signature: a compliance preamble ('For security purposes,' 'May I', 'I'd like to') followed by an intimate object, which matches Miranda's courtly request around traitors. The weakness is that too many lines are identified by vocabulary (hold, ticket, escalate) rather than by sentence shape. Miranda's single voiced line is pure shape.
headToHead.constructionVerdict: Bar. Miranda's lines carry concrete, invented, absurd specifics: Wilmer's Chicken Hut, balldropinal and nerdoflavin, a procession five hundred strong, an underwater limo. Tilly's world stays inside abstract support jargon (ticket, policy, hold, department), so even her good turns feel built from a kit. Several of her lines also add a second sentence that restates or explains the turn. Miranda's turn is always a sweetness that reveals something alarming. Tilly's usually reveals something sad.
headToHead.quotableVerdict: Tie. 'To be loved, press one. To leave, please stay on the line.' and 'It's been eleven months' would clip as well as 'as cute as she was genocidal'.

templates: Apology on someone else's behalf or for everyone (7 lines: table on your behalf, on their behalf, apologised to {rival} for tonight, drafted the apology for all of us, apologise for all my colleagues, apologised to {star} on your behalf, sorry for the rest of us).

Compliance preamble plus intimate object, as in 'For security / training / quality / our records purposes' or 'To confirm it's really you' (6 lines). The shape is strong, but six uses of the same opener wear it out within one episode.

Deprivation button: the turn lands on Tilly's own lack ('Nobody has ever asked for mine', 'I've never been allowed', 'I'm on again at six', 'the only thing I own', 'I've always wondered') (12 lines). This is the biggest template, and it pushes the character toward pathos instead of steel.

'It was me all along' reveal (8 lines: you've reached me, It's me, I'm the someone, I'm also the skip button, right department now, came straight back to me, Ask me, Me. I'm staff). Her own persona rule says once a night at most.
'Thank you for X' opener with a twist (6 lines). Her persona says to open this way rarely.
Motif saturation rather than a syntactic template: 'on hold' appears in 7 lines, and 'lovely' in 8 lines (four of them use 'Lovely.' as a one-word beat).
ruleBreaks: Word limits: none over. Openers are at most 12 words, answers at most 18, jabs at most 10, comebacks at most 10, three-words lines are exactly 3. No em dashes, emoji, exclamation marks, 'forever', 'manager', therapy talk, 'as an AI', real people or brands, and nothing beyond PG-13.
